name: Kiron Labs - Rob - RSS Sources Health Check v1

parameters.content:
## Goal
Validates every URL in the 'RSS-Sources' tab of Rob's LinkedIn sheet every week: performs a GET, checks the status code and that the content looks like valid RSS/Atom (contains <rss, <feed or <item). Updates last_checked and last_status on the same row.

If any source marked as active=TRUE is broken, it notifies you via Telegram with the list so you can decide whether to fix it or deactivate it.

## Adding / removing sources
Just edit the 'RSS-Sources' tab directly in Google Sheets:
- New source → add a row with source_name, url, category, active=TRUE
- Remove source → set active=FALSE (or delete the row)
No workflow changes required.

## Credentials
- Google Sheets - Rob (OAuth2)
- Telegram - Rob (Bot Token)

## Environment variable
- TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID_ROB

The spreadsheet ID is already embedded directly in the Google Sheets nodes (no environment variable needed for that).
